channel.title: Insider Media Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Insider Media Ltd (insidermedia.com)

item.title: Contractors to begin demolition of former Swansea school site
item.description: Contractors are to begin demolition of a former school site in Swansea as part of plans to build a new modern replacement.

item.title: 100k apprenticeships milestone reached in Wales - Welsh Government
item.description: More than 100,000 apprenticeships have been created this Senedd term, the Welsh Government has said.

item.title: Restored mill complex dating back to the 1700s hits the market - "one of the region's most distinctive commercial locations"
item.description: A collection of restored mill buildings which date back to the 1700s and form part of the Derwent Valley Mills World Heritage Site have been brought to market.

item.title: Go-ahead given to Lincolnshire holiday park proposals
item.description: A holiday park operator's plans for the creation of a new venue in Lincolnshire have received the green light.

item.title: 'A game-changer for us' - Gloucester specialist secures growth at Midlands food wholesaler
item.description: A company owned by a Gloucester-based coldstore specialist has played a key role in creating a new home for a food wholesaler in Branston near Burton-on-Trent.

item.title: Work starts on sheltered housing apartments and reablement centre
item.description: Construction work has commenced on a new affordable housing and reablement development in Haverfordwest.

item.title: Industrial cleaning firm secures funding to boost capacity
item.description: A West Yorkshire company that specialises in cleaning industrial components has secured funding to relocate, boost capacity and create jobs.

item.title: Persimmon bolsters West Midlands team with new land manager
item.description: Persimmon Homes West Midlands has appointed a new land manager to oversee its portfolio across the region.

item.title: Plans for 40 new homes in West Sussex village set for approval
item.description: Plans to build 40 homes on the outskirts of Turners Hill, a village in West Sussex, have been recommended for approval by the local council.

item.title: January sees temp roles in the South rise for first time in two years but staffing numbers down - KPMG and REC
item.description: The South of England recorded a further reduction in permanent staff appointments at the start of 2026 linked to low market confidence and a slowdown in hiring, according to the latest Report on Jobs from KPMG and REC.
